meta.title: 5 Places to Visit in Hue | What To Do in Hue
meta.description:
Hi everyone, 
Today, I will take you to Hue, one of the most romantic and ancient cities in Vietnam. Hue was the capital of Vietnam from 1802 to 1945, and it's known for the beautiful historical tombs of the Nguyen Dynasty. Let's explore 5 things to do in Hue with me in this video 

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Thankyou so much for bringing back such happy memories of my visit to Hue I really loved that combination of Vietnamese and French colonial style.I want to go back to visit the famous college there,visit the centre near the Imperial City run by people with mental disabilities (it sounds amazing especially as I work in this sector here in London UK) and at the city centre hotel where I stayed they had a scheme where hotel guests could volunteer to spend a few hours of their stay helping poor Vietnamese students with their English language.Sadly I only discovered this on my last day but I vowed to return as I felt it was a wonderful idea by the hotel manager.Sadly this damn virus situation as spoiled my plans but I am trying to remain patient.Being British I thought I might be able to help a few students with the mother tongue.Did you have a chance to visit Europe it's such a wonderful continent...nearly as lovely as Asia!And finally dear yes you must visit lovely Japan.The people are so polite and the service you receive everywhere is wonderful definitely no scams....and the trains run exactly to time ha not like here!!! I still remember those hot Vietnamese Summer days I love warm weather but even for me it was hot hot hot!!
With Blessings for your day.Steve

Hello Van !
Nice posting of video on Hue. It brings back memories of my trip there in 2017. Due to only a 2 day/1 night trip, I've only managed to visit the Imperial Palace & Thien Mu Pagoda. The palace compound was huge & take a lot of walking to see but was well worth it. The pagoda is nicely situated beside the Perfume River with breathtaking views.
Should have stay an extra night to visit the other attractions.
Nevertheless, I really enjoyed Hue & the scenic drive from Da Nang thru Hai Van Pass & Lang Co beach. The views are awesome. That trip was part of my Da Nang - Hue - Hoi An self planned visit. 
With proper planning, trips can be very smooth in Vietnam. Don't you agree?

comments.author: @quocnguyenngoc9272
comments.text: Of the Nguyen tombs, I prefer by far the tomb of Gia Long, the founder of the Nguyen dynasty. There is a bridge now so you can go there by road. I hired a boat (as the bridge was not finished then) and took "xe ôm" to go from the river banks to the tomb complex. It is quite a way out. On the way back, I hired a Ca Huế troupe (who came to the boat) to listen to traditional music on the Perfume river, a very pleasant experience. I should point out that the Nón Lá (the conical hat) nowadays is a lot smaller than the old design. The larger hat looks much better. You can still see women with the older, larger hats in the Northern highlands. In Huế, it should be nón bài thơ.
